description: Publish self-contained HTML to a Cloud site this account owns. Pass projectId instead of html to send a saved Studio page. Public env vars for that site are written into the static page. Private values are not. Cloud is not a Node host. ZIP uploads stay on POST /api/cloud/v1/{siteId} with a Cloud deploy key.

html.description: Complete self-contained HTML document, 180 KB or smaller.

projectId.description: Optional Studio project UUID. Sends that saved page instead of html.

name: deploy
title: Deploy site
